summary_en: Target payout ratio raised from 40% to 50%. Progressive dividend policy adopted for FY27–FY29 (no cuts, maintain or increase). FY27 annual dividend increased to ¥80/share from ¥70/share.
title_en: Notice regarding Change in Dividend Policy (Change in Target Payout Ratio and Introduction of Progressive Dividend) and Revision of Dividend Forecast for FY3/27
translation_en_brief: System Research resolved on 28 July 2026 to change its dividend policy effective FY27 (year ending 31 March 2027). The target payout ratio is raised from 40% to 50%. For the three-year medium-term plan covering FY27–FY29, the company adopts a progressive dividend policy, meaning it will maintain or increase dividends without cuts in principle, subject to extraordinary circumstances such as sharp earnings deterioration or material investments affecting financial health. The FY27 dividend forecast is revised upward by ¥10 per share, from ¥70 to ¥80 per share, reflecting stronger profitability and the new policy.
